name: Megarizoku ~Ingoku ni Kegareru Otome-tachi~
original_name: 牝狩賊 ～淫獄に穢れる乙女たち～
source:
The impenetrable country of Rugalant.

Women governed the country, ruled by its princess, the highest of its power. Men were of a lower class, and treated with less dignity.

There is one person, who plots to overthrow the country. And deep inside him, he will make sure the women bow down to man and...

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=936642]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
固若金汤的国家Rugalant。

这里由女性掌权，公主是国家的统治者，拥有至高无上的权力。男性则处于较低的阶层，得不到同等的尊重。

有一个人正谋划推翻这个国家。他在心底发誓，一定要让这些女人臣服于男人，然后……

（粗译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=936642]Getchu[/url]）
